lead_raw_text:
The structure of Hf₂Pd₂ (HfPd) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing four atoms across two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Hf and Pd centers adopt a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors each (6 Hf and 6 Pd), at distances from 2.8069 to 3.0861 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all four sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis indicates that Hf–Hf, Pd–Pd, and Hf–Pd 12-vertex coordination polyhedra exhibit corner-, edge-, and face-sharing contacts.
